ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity black central region to high-intensity white peripheral regions on the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmentation area extending from the central peduncle insertion point outwards, covering approximately two-thirds of the inner fluke area. High-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral portions of both lobes. Significant mottling and stippled transition zones between black and white areas. Small isolated dark circular clusters located in the distal white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged serration along the trailing boundary with an average frequency of 12-15 peaks per lobe and a pixel amplitude of 5-10 pixels. Notably larger, sharper peaks located near the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a gentle convex curve from the median notch towards the lateral tips, while the overall outer lobe sweep shows a slight concavity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the high-intensity white regions of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel dark linear disruptions observed on the distal end of the left lobe, consistent with diagonal rake mark patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small nicks and irregularities along the serrated trailing edge; scattered dark spots in white zones potentially representing parasitic or barnacle attachment sites.
